cancellation.scope: Cached analysis cancellation; a succeeded race does not establish cancellation latency.

memory.scope: Coordinator and live descendant RSS; sampled, shared pages can be double counted; not an OS high-water mark.
memory.childMemoryCoverage: No child captured; coordinator RSS alone cannot establish the worker memory gate.

scope: Backend timings on supplied media; no UI latency or accuracy claim. rank2000 is null unless 2000 real cached measurements exist. Sustained duration is reported rather than assumed to be a long-run test.
workerBuildProfile: Not asserted; supplied worker binary is independent of coordinator profile
